name: viridis-scope-desk
description: Draft evidence-linked job scopes and baseline-bound change requests from supplied facts for people and agents.

interface.longDescription: Turn a supplied brief into a reviewable job scope with deliverables, exclusions, observable acceptance criteria and missing decisions. Compare a proposed request with an explicitly selected baseline revision and draft a change request. Evidence quotes retain source IDs and original line numbers; proposed checks stay unexecuted. For service operators and agent builders. No code execution, MCP tools, signing, acceptance, pricing decisions or automatic sharing.
defaultPrompt: Scope this job from the supplied brief, including acceptance criteria and missing decisions.
Compare this proposed request with the selected baseline revision and draft a change request.

publication.release_notes: Adds verified public Scope Desk information, support and privacy links plus product usage terms. The two skills and shared evidence rules remain byte-identical to tested 0.1.5.
